verdict.rationale: The repo ships a first-party `skill-creator` meta-skill. It is described as "a skill for creating new skills and iteratively improving them." It can create, modify, and improve skills, measure their performance, benchmark them with variance analysis, and optimize descriptions for better triggering. A `template/SKILL.md` scaffold is also included. The packaging step is not shown as part of the meta-skill; plugin and marketplace packaging is documented separately in Claude Code docs. missing for 10: evidence that skill-creator itself handles packaging/distribution, independent or hands-on corroboration of skill-creator's workflow.
